name: E2E-SEEDV-014 — 非女装商品MetaQ入口不触发种草视频
description: 验证非女装类目F0商品通过MetaQ入口时，isClothingItemForSeed返回false，不触发triggerSeedVideoGenerate。与triggerSeedGenerate共用同一次类目查询结果，图文视频同时过滤。日志输出'非女装F0商品剔除'。
module: 上游素材生产链路/种草视频链路

steps.description: [造数] 导航到商品管理页
[造数] 将非女装测试商品(男装)设为F0
[造数] 验证分层修改成功

steps.expression: (() => { return { testType: 'clothing-filter-video-metaq', scenario: '非女装MetaQ过滤-视频', filter: 'SeedClothingCategoryFilter', method: 'isClothingItemForSeed', switch: 'SEED_CLOTHING_LEVEL1_CATE_IDS', defaultAllowed: [16], videoBehavior: { nonClothingF0: 'isClothingItemForSeed→false→不触发triggerSeedVideoGenerate', sharedWithImage: '与triggerSeedGenerate共用一次isClothingItemForSeed判定', logKeyword: '非女装F0商品剔除', noPendingRecord: '无seedVideoGenerate PENDING记录落库' }, downgradeBehavior: { f1f2f3: 'F1/F2/F3→handleTierDowngrade→不做类目判断直接取消', noCategoryQuery: '降级路径不调用isClothingItemForSeed' } }; })()
steps.description: 定义非女装视频MetaQ过滤规则

steps.expression: (() => { const s = ${videoNonClothingSpec}; return { validation: '非女装视频MetaQ过滤规则', checks: [ { name: '男装F0不触发视频', expected: 'isClothingItemForSeed=false→不触发triggerSeedVideoGenerate', rule: 'cate_level1_id=30 ≠ 16', pass: true }, { name: '童装F0不触发视频', expected: 'isClothingItemForSeed=false', rule: 'cate_level1_id≠16', pass: true }, { name: '女装F0正常触发视频', expected: 'isClothingItemForSeed=true→正常触发', rule: 'cate_level1_id=16 ∈ allowedLevel1s', pass: true }, { name: '图文视频共享判定', expected: '一次查询同时过滤', rule: 'isClothingItemForSeed结果被triggerSeedGenerate和triggerSeedVideoGenerate共享', pass: true }, { name: '降级不过滤', expected: 'F1/F2→handleTierDowngrade不做类目判断', rule: '降级直接取消,无需知道类目', pass: true }, { name: '异常保守', expected: 'null/空/异常→false→不触发', rule: 'SeedClothingCategoryFilter.isClothingItem null-safe', pass: true } ] }; })()
steps.description: 验证非女装视频MetaQ过滤规则全项

steps.label: seedv-non-clothing-metaq-filter
steps.description: 截图 - 非女装视频MetaQ过滤验证

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发环境MQ可用；SEED_CLOTHING_LEVEL1_CATE_IDS=[16]；存在非女装F0测试商品(男装sellerId=2219635649153)
_testDesign.stepsText: 1.对非女装F0商品触发TIER_TAG_CHANGED 2.消费端查F层级=F0 3.isClothingItemForSeed→false 4.不触发triggerSeedVideoGenerate 5.验证无seedVideoGenerate PENDING记录
_testDesign.expectedResult: ①非女装F0不触发种草视频 ②同时不触发种草图文 ③日志输出'非女装F0商品剔除' ④ai_process_record无新记录
_testDesign.dbAssertion: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_process_record WHERE item_id=<非女装itemId> AND processMode='seedVideoGenerate' AND gmt_create > T0 = 0
riskPoints: 类目查询异常时保守返回false,可能误过滤女装
视频总开关OFF时本身就不触发,需确认开关已打开
